question: What is the median site activation cycle time by IRB type for CASCADE-CKD?
How did randomization change at CASCADE-CKD sites that also run the REDWOOD-CKD competing trial?
What are the top screen failure reasons for CASCADE-CKD?
How has the share of CASCADE-CKD screen failures caused by SGLT2 inhibitor use changed by quarter?
Which trial is furthest behind its enrollment plan?
Which active CASCADE-CKD sites have randomized zero patients?
Is exclusion E4 (SGLT2 inhibitor within 12 weeks) a safety or an efficacy-design criterion, and how long until an eligibility amendment is effective?

content:
Halcyra Therapeutics (fictional sponsor) runs 5 active trials: CASCADE-CKD (HAL-301, Phase III, T2D + chronic kidney disease, target 1,200 randomized), TIDEWATER-HF (Phase III HFpEF), SENTRY-AF (Phase III atrial fibrillation), LUMEN-MASH (Phase IIb MASH) and ORCHID-1 (Phase I/II oncology). trial_id values are the acronyms, e.g. 'CASCADE-CKD'.
ENROLLMENT VS PLAN: use gold_trial_enrollment_monthly. cum_randomized = cumulative randomized patients; planned_cum_randomized = the protocol plan for that month. 'Today' = the row where month_start = date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()). pct_of_plan = cum_randomized / planned_cum_randomized. For monthly run rates use complete months only (is_complete_month = true).
SCREEN FAILURES: use gold_screen_fail_monthly (or screen_fail_reasons for patient-level rows). criterion_id is the REAL reason: the criterion the site coded, or — when the site coded 'OTHER' — the criterion AI Functions (ai_classify) read from the coordinator's note. site_coded_failures vs ai_recovered_failures shows how much the EDC coding under-counts a criterion. E4 = SGLT2 inhibitor within 12 weeks (exclusion); I3 = UACR; E7 = potassium > 4.8; I2 = eGFR. Share of screen failures = failures for a criterion / all failures of that trial. sglt2i_stable_12wk (screen_fail_reasons) marks E4 failures on a stable SGLT2i dose — the patients a stable-background-SGLT2i amendment would bring back.
SITES: gold_site_performance has one row per trial site (status active / activating / not_activated). A ZERO ENROLLER is is_zero_enroller = true (active ≥ 6 months, 0 randomized). Randomization rate = randomized_per_month. Competing trial overlap: has_competing_trial / competing_trial (REDWOOD-CKD by Nephrexa Bio, opened in January 2026 at Southeast and Texas sites) with rand_per_month_before_competitor (6 months before) vs rand_per_month_since_competitor.
SITE ACTIVATION CYCLE TIME = cycle_time_days (site selected → activated), only for activated sites. irb_type central vs local explains most of the difference. Report medians.
CANDIDATE / RESCUE SITES: site_scores holds site_enrollment_model@champion predictions for every network site: predicted_rate_current vs predicted_rate_amended (randomized/month if E4 is amended), est_activation_months, expected_randomized_12m, rescue_rank (candidates only: not yet selected, no competing DKD trial, ≥ 300 amended-eligible patients). cascade_status = 'candidate' means not selected for CASCADE-CKD.
CATCHMENT: site_catchment has de-identified EHR-network patient counts within 30 miles of each site, criterion by criterion; eligible_current_protocol vs eligible_amended_e4. population_trends has the quarterly share of the T2D+CKD population on an SGLT2 inhibitor by region (the 2023 feasibility assumed ~15%).
Race/ethnicity in screening_log is for diversity-plan monitoring only. Always show percentages rounded to 1 decimal.
ROUTING: numbers, counts, amounts, rates, trends -> query the TABLES (SQL); never answer numbers from a document. Policy, procedure, guideline, contract and 'what does the document say' questions -> search the attached documents and cite the document name + section.

question: How has the share of CASCADE-CKD screen failures caused by SGLT2 inhibitor use changed by quarter?
sql: SELECT concat(year(screen_month), '-Q', quarter(screen_month)) AS quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN criterion_id = 'E4' THEN screen_failures ELSE 0 END) AS sglt2i_failures, SUM(screen_failures) AS all_failures, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN criterion_id = 'E4' THEN screen_failures ELSE 0 END) / SUM(screen_failures), 1) AS sglt2i_share_pct FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_screen_fail_monthly WHERE trial_id = 'CASCADE-CKD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: What is the median site activation cycle time by IRB type for CASCADE-CKD?
sql: SELECT irb_type, COUNT(*) AS activated_sites, PERCENTILE(cycle_time_days, 0.5) AS median_cycle_days, ROUND(AVG(cycle_time_days)) AS avg_cycle_days FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_site_performance WHERE trial_id = 'CASCADE-CKD' AND cycle_time_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY irb_type ORDER BY median_cycle_days DESC

question: Which trial is furthest behind its enrollment plan?
sql: SELECT t.acronym, t.phase, t.target_enrollment, m.cum_randomized AS randomized_to_date, m.planned_cum_randomized AS planned_to_date, ROUND(100 * m.cum_randomized / m.planned_cum_randomized, 1) AS pct_of_plan FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_trial_enrollment_monthly m JOIN healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.trials t USING (trial_id) WHERE m.month_start = date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()) ORDER BY pct_of_plan

question: What are the top screen failure reasons for CASCADE-CKD?
sql: SELECT criterion_id, MAX(criterion_name) AS criterion, SUM(screen_failures) AS screen_failures, ROUND(100 * SUM(screen_failures) / SUM(SUM(screen_failures)) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct, SUM(site_coded_failures) AS coded_by_sites, SUM(ai_recovered_failures) AS recovered_by_ai FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_screen_fail_monthly WHERE trial_id = 'CASCADE-CKD' GROUP BY criterion_id ORDER BY screen_failures DESC

question: Which active CASCADE-CKD sites have randomized zero patients?
sql: SELECT site_name, city, state, activation_date, months_active, screened, randomized, has_competing_trial FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_site_performance WHERE trial_id = 'CASCADE-CKD' AND is_zero_enroller ORDER BY months_active DESC

question: How did randomization change at CASCADE-CKD sites that also run the REDWOOD-CKD competing trial?
sql: SELECT has_competing_trial, COUNT(*) AS sites, ROUND(AVG(rand_per_month_before_competitor), 2) AS rand_per_site_month_6m_before, ROUND(AVG(rand_per_month_since_competitor), 2) AS rand_per_site_month_since FROM healthcare_lifesciences.trial_site_selection.gold_site_performance WHERE trial_id = 'CASCADE-CKD' AND status = 'active' AND has_competing_trial GROUP BY has_competing_trial
